guard/30541.htm.text: Protector Paion: Hmm, I'm Paion, the leader of the Defenders of this Dwarven Village. Mind your manners around here, OK? This area is known as the Mining Region of the Spine Mountains .

links.text: "Who's the Lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/30541-1.htm.text: Protector Paion: What? Are you kidding me? You don't know the Spine Mine? It is where we live now -- the home of us Dwarves and also a working mine!
